title_en: At a clock time: ob osmih
card_en: At a clock time, say ob and change the number: ob eni, ob dveh, ob treh, ob štirih, and from five on it ends in -ih: ob petih, ob osmih. Ob kateri uri? asks at what time.

quick_check.explain_en: After ob, a clock time changes: sedem becomes ob sedmih.

helper_de: ob works like German um: um acht, ob osmih. German leaves the number as it is; Slovenian changes it.
helper_en: Telling the time needs no ob and no change: ura je osem. Only at a time takes ob: ob osmih.
